fields.summary: Retail customer login with user ID and password
fields.description: Customers sign in to internet banking with a unique user ID and password. Successful authentication lands on the account summary. Failed attempts must not disclose whether the user ID exists.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Valid credentials open the account summary
- Invalid credentials show a generic error
- Password field is masked

fields.summary: Step-up MFA with SMS OTP on login from a new device
fields.description: After password validation, a new or untrusted device requires a 6-digit SMS OTP. Trusted devices skip OTP for 90 days unless the customer revokes them.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- OTP is required on first login from a new browser
- Expired or wrong OTP is rejected without completing login
- Successful OTP marks the device as trusted

fields.summary: Idle session timeout and explicit logout
fields.description: Internet banking sessions expire after 10 minutes of inactivity. Customers can also logout from the header. Both paths invalidate the server session and require a fresh login.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Idle timeout returns the customer to login with a session-expired message
- Logout clears cookies and blocks Back-button reuse of cached pages

fields.description: After login the customer sees every eligible retail account: product type, masked account number, available balance, and product nickname. A hide-balance control is available for shoulder-surfing protection.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- All active CASA and term-deposit accounts appear
- Available balance matches the core banking snapshot used by the channel
- Hide/show balance toggles amounts without a page reload error

fields.description: From summary the customer opens an account to see ledger-style recent transactions, holds, and joint-account indicators.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Last 10 transactions display with date, description, debit/credit, running balance
- Joint accounts show a joint indicator
- Pending authorizations are labelled

fields.description: Customers move money between their own savings and current accounts in real time. A confirmation step shows from, to, amount, and remarks before submit.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Transfer posts to both accounts immediately when within limits and funds
- Confirmation screen is mandatory
- Receipt shows a channel reference number

fields.description: Customers send funds to an active beneficiary using IMPS (low value, immediate) or NEFT (batch). High-value payments require OTP.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Only active beneficiaries appear as destinations
- IMPS succeeds within the IMPS cap
- High-value transfer prompts OTP before commit

fields.description: The channel enforces bank-max and customer-set daily and per-transaction limits for third-party transfers. Own-account transfers use a higher internal cap.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Breach of per-transaction limit is blocked before OTP
- Breach of remaining daily limit is blocked
- Customer can view remaining limit for the day

fields.description: Customers pay utilities and card bills from a registered biller list. Where the biller supports fetch, the outstanding amount is retrieved before pay.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Pay succeeds against a registered biller with a valid amount
- Fetch-and-pay uses the fetched outstanding as the default amount
- Receipt includes biller name and consumer number

fields.description: Customers add a biller by category, biller name, and consumer number. Invalid consumer numbers returned by the biller network are rejected.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Valid consumer number creates an active biller
- Invalid consumer number shows a biller-network error and does not save

fields.description: New beneficiaries require a cooling-off period (4 hours) before they can receive funds. Duplicate account numbers for the same customer are rejected. Nickname edits do not reset cool-off.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Add beneficiary succeeds and status is Cooling-off until the period ends
- Transfer is blocked during cool-off
- Duplicate account number is rejected
- Delete removes the beneficiary from the payee list

fields.summary: Account statements view, download, and email
fields.description: Customers view up to 12 months of statements, download PDF or CSV, and email a statement to the registered address. Date ranges must be valid and within the retention window.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Default view is last 30 days of posted transactions
- PDF and CSV downloads succeed for a valid range
- End date before start date is rejected
- Email statement is sent to the registered email only

fields.summary: View debit and credit cards linked to the customer
fields.description: The cards hub lists debit and credit cards with masked PAN, product name, status, and linked account.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- All active and blocked cards for the CIF are listed
- PAN is masked except last 4

fields.summary: Card controls: block, unblock, PIN set, international usage
fields.description: Customers can temporarily block a debit card, unblock it, set/reset PIN via OTP, and toggle international usage.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Block changes status to Blocked and declines subsequent POS in the simulator
- Unblock restores Active
- PIN set requires OTP
- International toggle persists

fields.description: Within the bank maximum, customers raise or lower daily third-party transfer limits. Changes above the current limit may require OTP.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- View shows bank max, current daily limit, remaining today
- Update within max succeeds
- Update above bank max is rejected

fields.description: Customers opt in or out of SMS and email alerts for debits, credits, and successful logins.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Enable SMS debit alerts persists and is shown as On
- Disable email login alerts persists
- Preferences survive logout

fields.summary: Lock internet banking after repeated failed logins
fields.description: Three consecutive invalid password attempts lock the user ID for 30 minutes or until the customer unlocks via the contact centre / forgot-password flow.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Third consecutive failure locks the ID
- A fourth attempt with the correct password is still rejected while locked
- Generic lock message does not confirm the password was correct

fields.description: Transfers and bill payments that exceed available balance are blocked. A second submit of the same amount/beneficiary within two minutes warns of a possible duplicate.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Amount greater than available balance is rejected with insufficient-funds
- Duplicate warning is shown; customer can cancel or confirm

fields.description: Customers reset a forgotten password using registered mobile OTP and a debit-card PIN or security questions, then set a new password that meets complexity rules.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- OTP to registered mobile is required
- New password meeting policy is accepted and old password cannot be reused immediately
- After reset the customer can login with the new password

fields.description: Customers may schedule a one-time transfer for a future business date. The debit occurs on that date if funds and limits allow; otherwise the schedule fails and an alert is sent.
fields.acceptanceCriteria:
- Future date is accepted for the next 30 days excluding today
- Scheduled instruction appears in the activity list as Pending
